title: Junior Accountant
lines: Work Site:Angeles City / San Fernando City
Processes financial transactions and maintains accounting records under client procedures and company standards.
Ideal for detail-oriented, analytical candidates. Training provided.
Process invoices and financial documents accurately and on time.
Process owner reimbursements; verify supporting documents.
Process lot owner charges and other transactions.
Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation.
Process strata levy transactions in the system.
Process work orders and quotation requests.
Generate strata certificates and finance documents.
Perform filing, document management and electronic record keeping.
Maintain financial files, trackers and records.
Enter and maintain financial data in company systems.
Keep financial records accurate and current.
Collaborate with teams to meet accounting deadlines.
Assist with accounting reports and administrative projects.
Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned.
Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Accounting Technology, Management Accounting, Financial Management or related business courses.
Accounting, bookkeeping, finance, administrative or data entry experience is an advantage, not required.
Accounting or finance internship or OJT is an advantage.
Basic understanding of accounting principles and processes.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Good computer navigation and data entry skills.
Ability to learn accounting software and client systems quickly.
Strong numerical aptitude and attention to detail.
High accuracy and attention to detail.
Excellent organisational and time management skills.
Good written and verbal English communication.
Ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
Ability to work independently and within a team.
Professional and dependable; maintains confidentiality and integrity with financial information.

title: Mid-Level Accountant (Nightshift)
lines: Manages mid-tier financial operations for strata-titled properties, between junior and senior roles, preparing and reviewing financial statements.
Oversee invoice and credit processing, payment runs, lot owner charges, reimbursements, daily bank downloads and reconciliations.
Strike levies, issue levy notices, handle debt recovery and answer owner and client levy inquiries by email and phone.
Draft property budgets, log management activities and reconcile accounts for transparent fund allocation.
Assist with year-end closing: adjusting charges and interest, reallocating codes and funds, preparing audit files.
• Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Accounting Technology, Finance or related business courses (fresh graduates welcome).
• 2–4 years' general accounting, accounts payable or financial reporting experience (BPO, real estate or offshore client work preferred).
• End-to-end accounting processes (AP, AR, bank reconciliations, GL).
• Intermediate to advanced MS Excel (data analysis, formulas, financial formatting).
• Aptitude for specialised strata accounting platforms and ERP tools.
• Strong analytical skills and numerical accuracy.
• Excellent written and verbal English for levy queries.
• Strong time management and problem-solving abilities

title: Senior Accountant
lines: Leads financial operations for strata properties, ensuring financial compliance and accurate accounting, and overseeing reporting, tax, audits, process improvement and staff mentorship.
Prepare accurate strata-compliant financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow); deliver on time to property managers and stakeholders.
II. Building Set Up & Tax Compliance:
Manage new building setups, GST-BAS lodgments and full tax compliance across strata portfolios.
Facilitate external audits, provide documentation and resolve findings within designated timelines.
Streamline accounting workflows, establish best practices and supervise and mentor junior and mid-level staff.
Oversee AP, payment runs, daily bank reconciliations, property budgets, levy striking, debt recovery and complex year-end fund reallocations.
• Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy or Finance (CPA certification an advantage).
• 4–5+ years' accounting experience, including 2 years in a senior or lead role with complex reporting and tax compliance (BPO/offshore strata preferred).
• Advanced general ledger, financial reporting standards, GST/BAS and tax filing knowledge.
• Expert MS Excel (advanced formulas, financial modelling, pivot tables).
• High proficiency in property management and strata accounting software.
• Strong leadership, mentorship and collaboration skills.
• Advanced analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking.
• Excellent written and verbal English for stakeholder and auditor liaison.

title: Human Resources Assistant
lines: Administrative and operational support across HR functions, primarily Industrial Relations, HR Compliance and Employee Relations.
Also covers attendance and leave, performance management and other HR initiatives.
Manage employee and Industrial Relations cases.
Document employee concerns, policy violations and disciplinary cases.
Prepare Notices to Explain (NTEs), written warnings, disciplinary notices and HR correspondence.
Coordinate administrative hearings, employee meetings and case discussions.
Gather information and documentation for investigations.
Monitor ongoing cases and complete follow-ups.
Address employee concerns and grievances; escalate when needed.
Support company policies, the Employee Handbook and Code of Conduct.
Identify recurring concerns and escalate trends to HR management.
Prepare documents for internal audits, compliance reviews and government requirements.
Monitor HR documents and records for completeness and updates.
Maintain organised, confidential employee files and records.
Support policy implementation and HR documentation.
Provide day-to-day administrative support to HR.
Prepare HR reports, trackers, presentations and documentation.
Prepare HR letters, certificates, notices and employee documents.
Respond to employee enquiries and requests.
Coordinate HR activities, meetings and communications.
Assist the Recruitment team with administrative coordination.
V. Employee Engagement and HR Initiatives
Coordinate employee engagement activities and HR programmes.
Support HR events, surveys and internal communications.
Gather employee feedback and prepare summaries.
Support HR initiatives on employee experience, culture and retention.
Participate in HR projects and improvement initiatives.
Provide backup to other HR functions during peak workload or absence.
Perform other HR duties assigned by the HR Manager or People & Culture Head.
0–1 year experience in HR, particularly Industrial Relations
Industrial & Employee Relations Documentation: Labour standards, due process; drafting Notices to Explain (NTEs), warnings, disciplinary notices and hearing minutes.
HR Compliance & Records Management: Confidential physical and digital employee files, compliance deadlines, audit and government documentation.
HR Information Systems (HRIS) & Tracking: HR database software, attendance/leave tools; MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reports and presentations.
General HR Operations: Coordinate recruitment workflows, onboarding orientations, employee engagement and feedback.
Discretion & Confidentiality: Integrity and tact with sensitive personnel records, investigations and disciplinary proceedings.
Active Listening & Conflict Resolution: Emotional intelligence for grievances and sensitive discussions, with empathy and impartiality.
Exceptional Written & Verbal Communication: Clear, precise communication for HR notices, policy and organisational liaison.
Attention to Detail: Accuracy in HR documentation, case monitoring, record-keeping and timelines.
Organisational & Time Management: Prioritise multi-faceted tasks across employee relations, recruitment and administrative deadlines.
